name: false-alarm rate trend makes observability noise measurable

scenarios.name: each emitted alert logs a verdict the sweep already computed

steps.text: <alert> fires and the operator sweep classifies it as <verdict>
exactly one record is appended to the alerts log
the record carries when it fired

examples.alert: a self-cancelling NO-OP within one sweep

scenarios.name: a pure aggregator yields per-type false-positive rate over a window

steps.text: a log of alert records spanning more than one window
some records are false-positive and some are actionable
each window reports that type's false-positive rate
the aggregation reads no files of its own

scenarios.name: the alerts log is append-only and excluded from version control

steps.text: the alerts log already holds earlier records
a further alert record is emitted
the earlier records are still present unchanged
the log is excluded from version control

scenarios.name: a telemetry write failure does not change alert emission

steps.text: the alerts log cannot be written
an alert that would normally fire is evaluated
the alert still fires or suppresses exactly as before
the operator sweep is not left waiting on the log

background.text: alert telemetry emits to the alerts log
